faq.q: Can I try Verse without paying?
faq.a: Yes. Every new account gets a 14-day trial with Pro features (5 GB storage, 3 Verse Homes, 3 films and more), then moves to Free. Free has no time limit: 1 GB storage, 1 Verse Home and 1 film a month.

faq.q: What happens when my trial ends?
faq.a: You move to Free. Nothing is deleted and your scenes keep opening; creating more needs a plan. Upgrade during the trial for 25% off your first 3 months on monthly plans or 20% off your first year on annual plans.

faq.q: What happens when I reach an allowance?
faq.a: We tell you at 80% and again at 100%. At 100% that action stops until you upgrade or your month resets. Published scenes never break: if bandwidth runs out on Free, viewers get a lighter version and you see a notice.
On paid plans you will be able to go past an allowance and pay only for the extra. It is coming soon; until then, reaching an allowance asks you to upgrade and nothing extra is charged.
One-time prepaid packs of Verse Homes and films, made for WhatsApp: 10 homes and 10 films for $12, or 50 of each for $59. They are used after your plan’s monthly allowance and do not expire.
Annual is billed as 10 months: two months free on every plan.
Starter includes 1 seat, Pro 3 and Scale 10. Each extra seat is $15 a month (10× that billed annually).

faq.q: Do my viewers need a plan?
faq.a: No. Anyone can open a published scene on any phone or laptop, whatever plan its owner is on.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel or downgrade?
faq.a: You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for, then move to the lower plan. Your scenes stay online.
We retry, and your plan keeps working for 7 days while you update your card. After that the account moves to Free.

faq.q: I subscribed before these plans. What changes?
faq.a: Nothing you pay. Existing subscriptions keep their plan and price, and get the new allowances wherever those are higher.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Customers in India pay in rupees (cards, UPI, net banking); everyone else pays in US dollars. Checkout is run by our payment partner Dodo Payments, the merchant of record, which adds the right sales tax, VAT or GST for your country and issues the invoice.

faq.q: Can I use a discount code?
faq.a: Yes. Enter it at checkout, or open a link with the code in it. One code per purchase unless the code says it can be combined.
Yes, within 7 days of your first payment or of an annual renewal. See the refund policy at /refunds.
